mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reports (report_id, report_name, report_type, display_name, description, sql_query) VALUES (#{report.reportId}, #{report.reportName}, #{report.reportType}, #{report.displayName}, #{report.description}, #{sql})

INSERT INTO report_params (report_id, param_index, data_type, is_required, param_name, display_name, description, placeholder) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{index}, #{dataType}, #{required}, #{name}, #{displayName}, #{description}, #{placeholder})

INSERT INTO report_fields (report_id, field_index, data_type, column_name, field_name, display_name, description) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{index}, #{dataType}, #{columnName}, #{name}, #{displayName}, #{description})
INSERT INTO report_metadata (report_id, name, func_index, field_index, description) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{name}, #{func_index}, #{field_index}, #{description})
INSERT INTO report_group_reports (report_id, report_group_id, start_date) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{reportGroupId}, #{startDate}) ON CONFLICT (report_id, report_group_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO report_group_schedules (report_id, report_group_id, parameters, timezone, execution_schedule, send_to) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{reportGroupId}, #{parameters,typeHandler=dev.olegz.vf.registry.dao.handlers.StringMapTypeHandler}, #{timezone}, #{schedule}, #{sendTo}) ON CONFLICT (report_id, report_group_id) DO UPDATE SET parameters = EXCLUDED.parameters, timezone = EXCLUDED.timezone, execution_schedule = EXCLUDED.execution_schedule, send_to = EXCLUDED.send_to
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM report_group_schedules WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND report_group_id = #{reportGroupId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.report_id, r.report_name, r.display_name, r.description, r.report_type, r.sql_query, r.dictionary_sql, rp.param_name, rp.param_index, rp.data_type AS "param_type", rp.is_required AS "param_required", rp.display_name AS "param_disp", rp.description AS "param_desc", rp.placeholder, rf.field_name, rf.data_type AS "field_type", rf.field_index, rf.column_name AS "field_column", rf.display_name AS "field_disp", rf.description AS "field_desc", rm.name AS "meta_name", rm.func_index AS "meta_func_index", rm.field_index AS "meta_field_index", rm.description AS "meta_desc" FROM reports r JOIN report_fields rf ON rf.report_id = r.report_id LEFT OUTER JOIN report_params rp ON rp.report_id = r.report_id LEFT OUTER JOIN report_metadata rm ON rm.report_id = r.report_id WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId}

SELECT r.report_id, r.report_type, r.report_name, r.display_name, r.description, r.dictionary_sql, rf.field_name, rf.field_index, rf.data_type AS "field_type", rf.column_name AS "field_column", rf.display_name AS "field_disp", rf.description AS "field_desc" FROM reports r JOIN report_fields rf ON r.report_id = rf.report_id WHERE rf.report_id = #{reportId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM report_group_schedules rgs WHERE rgs.report_id = r.report_id AND rgs.report_group_id = #{reportGroupId})
mapper.sql: r.report_id, r.report_name, r.display_name, r.description, r.report_type, r.display_info, rgr.report_group_id, rgr.report_id AS "report_group_report_id", rgr.start_date, rgs.parameters, rgs.send_to, rgs.execution_schedule, rgs.last_execution_date, rgs.next_execution_date, rp.param_name, rp.param_index, rp.data_type AS "param_type", rp.is_required AS "param_required", rp.display_name AS "param_disp", rp.description AS "param_desc", rp.placeholder, rf.field_name, rf.field_index, rf.data_type AS "field_type", rf.column_name AS "field_column", rf.display_name AS "field_disp", rf.description AS "field_desc", rg.name AS "groupName", rg.description AS "groupDescription", rm.name AS "meta_name", rm.func_index AS "meta_func_index", rm.field_index AS "meta_field_index", rm.description AS "meta_desc"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM report_groups rg JOIN report_group_reports rgr ON rgr.report_group_id = rg.report_group_id LEFT OUTER JOIN report_group_schedules rgs ON rgs.report_id = rgr.report_id AND rgs.report_group_id = rgr.report_group_id JOIN reports r ON r.report_id = rgr.report_id AND r.report_type IN (0, 1) JOIN report_fields rf ON rf.report_id = r.report_id LEFT OUTER JOIN report_params rp ON rp.report_id = r.report_id LEFT OUTER JOIN report_metadata rm ON rm.report_id = r.report_id WHERE rg.organizational_type = 0 AND rg.report_group_id = #{reportGroupId} AND r.report_id = #{reportId} AND r.report_type = #{reportType}

SELECT , rgo.assigned_at AS "organization_assigned_at", rgo.organization_id FROM organizations_hierarchy oh JOIN report_group_organizations rgo ON rgo.organization_id = oh.parent_organization_id JOIN report_groups rg ON rg.report_group_id = rgo.report_group_id JOIN report_group_reports rgr ON rgr.report_group_id = rgo.report_group_id LEFT OUTER JOIN report_group_schedules rgs ON rgs.report_id = rgr.report_id AND rgs.report_group_id = rgr.report_group_id JOIN reports r ON r.report_id = rgr.report_id AND r.report_type IN (0, 1) JOIN report_fields rf ON rf.report_id = r.report_id LEFT OUTER JOIN report_params rp ON rp.report_id = r.report_id LEFT OUTER JOIN report_metadata rm ON rm.report_id = r.report_id WHERE oh.child_organization_id = #{organizationId} AND rgo.report_group_id = #{reportGroupId} AND r.report_id = #{reportId} AND r.report_type = #{reportType}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_group_organizations (organization_id, report_group_id, assigned_at) SELECT #{organizationId}, #{reportGroupId}, #{assignedAt} FROM report_groups WHERE report_group_id = #{reportGroupId} AND organizational_type = 1
mapper.select: SELECT rgo.report_group_id, rgo.organization_id, rgo.assigned_at FROM report_group_organizations rgo JOIN organizations_hierarchy oh ON oh.parent_organization_id = rgo.organization_id WHERE oh.child_organization_id = #{organizationId} AND rgo.report_group_id = #{reportGroupId} LIMIT 1

SELECT rgo.report_group_id, oh.child_organization_id AS organization_id, rgo.assigned_at, o.timezone FROM report_group_organizations rgo JOIN organizations_hierarchy oh ON oh.parent_organization_id = rgo.organization_id JOIN organizations o ON o.organization_id = oh.child_organization_id WHERE o.is_deleted = 0

SELECT rg.report_group_id, rg.description, rg.name, org.parent_organization_id AS "organization_id"
, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM report_group_reports rgr, reports r WHERE rgr.report_group_id = rg.report_group_id AND r.report_id = rgr.report_id AND r.report_type = 1) AS "analytic"
FROM report_groups rg LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT rgo.report_group_id, oh.parent_organization_id FROM organizations_hierarchy oh, report_group_organizations rgo WHERE oh.child_organization_id = #{organizationId} AND rgo.organization_id = oh.parent_organization_id ) org ON org.report_group_id = rg.report_group_id WHERE rg.organizational_type = 1
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM report_group_reports rgr, reports r WHERE rgr.report_group_id = rg.report_group_id AND r.report_id = rgr.report_id AND r.report_type = 1)

SELECT rgs.schedule_id, rgs.report_id, rgs.report_group_id, rgs.parameters, rgs.timezone, rgs.execution_schedule, rgs.last_execution_date, rgs.next_execution_date, rgs.send_to, rg.organizational_type FROM report_group_schedules rgs JOIN report_groups rg ON rg.report_group_id = rgs.report_group_id JOIN reports r ON r.report_id = rgs.report_id AND r.report_type IN (0, 1) WHERE (rgs.next_execution_date IS NULL OR rgs.next_execution_date <= #{date})

SELECT rgs.schedule_id, rgs.report_id, rgs.report_group_id, rgs.parameters, rgs.timezone, rgs.execution_schedule, rgs.last_execution_date, rgs.next_execution_date, rgs.send_to, rg.organizational_type FROM report_group_schedules rgs JOIN report_groups rg ON rg.report_group_id = rgs.report_group_id WHERE rgs.report_id = #{reportId}

SELECT rgs.schedule_id, rgs.report_id, rgs.report_group_id, rgs.parameters, rgs.timezone, rgs.execution_schedule, rgs.last_execution_date, rgs.next_execution_date, rgs.send_to, rg.organizational_type FROM report_group_schedules rgs JOIN report_groups rg ON rg.report_group_id = rgs.report_group_id WHERE rgs.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_execution_history ( report_id, schedule_id, schedule_date, execution_date, execution_time, on_demand, output, object_id, analytic_output, organization_id, error_message, row_count, metadata) VALUES ( #{reportId}, #{scheduleId}, #{scheduleDate}, #{executionDate}, #{executionTime}, #{onDemand}, #{blobOutput}, #{objectId}, #{analyticOutput}, #{organizationId}, #{errorMessage}, #{rowCount}, #{metadata,typeHandler=dev.olegz.vf.registry.dao.handlers.StringMapTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT r.report_id, r.report_name, e.execution_date, e.error_message, e.output AS "blobOutput", EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM report_group_schedules s WHERE s.schedule_id = e.schedule_id AND s.report_group_id = 1) AS multi_cloud FROM report_execution_history e JOIN reports r ON r.report_id = e.report_id WHERE e.object_id = #{objectId} LIMIT 1
